First stand on your roof or as high as you can get outdoors and see if you can get a better signal.  Switch the phone to 3G as well, sometimes 3G signal is stronger than 4G and it can do 30mbps on a mobile network provider so a lot faster than slow broadband.

If you can get a couple (ideally 3 or more but you can probably work with 2) of 3G bars on your phone you might be in business.  Antennas connect to the modem that the provider provides, you'll be responsible for fitting it and aiming it though - they just provide a 3G/4G/5G modem.

Ideally you want the antenna high as it can go, might have to put a pole on your roof but you can maybe piggyback onto a TV antenna pole if you have one.  You then have to run the cables from the antenna into the house and to the modem, it can be a bit of work doing this so it's very worth checking the signal strength first.  

You'll also need to know exactly where the mobile phone mast you're going to use is because the best antennas are directional - you have to point them in the direction of the mast.  A signal finding app on your phone is good for finding the direction of the mast you're connecting to.  If you can see the mast from your roof then you're definitely in business, line of sight is ideal with as few obstructions in the way as possible.
